dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: What a showing from the Knights of Favonius! Most of them are youngsters without much combat experience, but they do have an adventurous spirit! Not bad. Not bad at all!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If I had to criticize, then I would say that they do drag their feet a little, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If it was always their intention to send me an adventure commission, they really didn't have to take a whole day to decide that.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, I must be a little drunk... Well, it doesn't matter. What does matter is that I'm treating tonight!
